sources.title: Hugging Face: Transformers runs llama.cpp quants (Sep 22)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Hugging Face added efficient GGUF execution in Transformers via from_pretrained gguf_file loading, transformers serve OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ggml Metal kernels through the kernels library, and generate-loop optimizations (mask drop, deferred stopping).
Vendor benchmarks show Transformers close to llama.cpp across three checkpoints on MacBook Pro M2 Max; llama-bench decode-only vs generate-including-prefill asymmetry explicitly disclosed.
claims.context: Vendor-run benchmarks with disclosed method asymmetry.

claims.text: Explicit limitations: packed inference path MPS-only; padded batches lower performance; arch coverage limited to Qwen3.5 dense/MoE plus compatible Qwen3.8; llama.cpp remains the recommended engine for pure efficient local inference.

limitations.text: Parity is approximate and hardware-bound (M2 Max only); no cross-platform claim.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: X walkthroughs (markfenner INDEPENDENT; EfemeraTt/viralai_jp COMMUNITY) are consistent but not proof.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
